nodes.label: Valora Impact
nodes.rationale: Uses only events with defined attribution and avoids unsupported environmental claims.

nodes.label: Public operation readiness
nodes.rationale: Operating real transactions needs separate operational, retention, security, and Indonesian trade rule decisions.

nodes.label: Atomic completion consistency
nodes.rationale: Owner, status, transfer, Passport, and Impact changes commit together or fail together.

nodes.label: Idempotent transaction completion
nodes.rationale: Repeated completion must produce no duplicate ownership transfer, Passport event, or Impact event.

nodes.label: Off platform payment and handover
nodes.rationale: Users arrange payment and delivery directly during MVP; user confirmations are recorded without claiming independent payment or physical verification.
